gate_bias_applicability.verdict: NOT APPLICABLE at -5/+18 V; NOT DIRECTLY APPLICABLE at 0/+15 V without qualification.
gate_bias_applicability.reason: Qg (107 nC), Qgd (36 nC) and Vplateau (5.0 V) are specified only at VGS=0 to 10 V, and RDS(on) only at VGS=10 V. The datasheet publishes no gate charge, plateau or switching-energy figures at 0/+15 V or -5/+18 V. Driving at 0/+15 V would move more charge than the 0/+10 V numbers; the difference is not quantified in this document and must not be inferred. Eoss is a function of VDS only (VGS=0), so it is gate-bias independent.
gate_bias_applicability.accepted_use: The six values are applicable as-is only for a 0/+10 V (or lower-Vgs) drive, or as a documented conservative/typical anchor when the campaign explicitly labels the 0/+15 V mismatch.
